Name: Show NPC Names
Author: xDuc
Description:
[quote][b][/b]Hello! I'm dvkin, and this is my very first mod created from scratch. I hope you enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed making it. Your feedback is highly appreciated and will help me improve future versions of this mod. Thank you for your support ![/quote]
Show NPC Names 2.0.0 Update Announcement
[spoiler]
[b]Update AnnouncementI am thrilled to announce the upcoming release of version 3.0.0 of my mod "Show NPC Names" within a week. This major update will introduce several important improvements.[/b]

[b]What's New in Version 2.0.0:In-Game Menu:
[/b]
[list]
[*]A new in-game menu will allow you to configure the mod directly without having to exit Stardew Valley.
[*]
[/list][b]Color Change System and Background Addition:[/b]
[list]
[*]You will now be able to change the color of the displayed names and add a background beneath the names to enhance visibility.
[*]
[/list][b]Improved Compatibility with Other Mods:
[/b][list]
[*]Significant improvements have been made to ensure better compatibility with other mods.
[*]
[/list][b]Display Issue Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]I have worked on resolving name display issues, especially those caused by interaction with certain mods. Although this problem currently affects only one person, I am doing my best to fix it.
[*]
[/list][b]More Name Display Options:[/b]
[list]
[*]More options for name display, including those of farm animals, children, pets, monsters, and items.
[*]
[/list][b]Participation and Feedback:Your feedback is essential to continue improving this mod. If you have ideas for additional features that might be useful, please feel free to share them. Your suggestions are welcome![/b]

[b]Availability:The 2.0.0 update will be available in a few days. I am currently putting the final touches to ensure everything works perfectly.[/b]

[size=1]A tiny reminder: Thank you for your feedback, and don't forget to leave an endorsement on the mod page. :3
[/size]
[b]Happy gaming to all, and see you soon in Stardew Valley![/b]

[b]Sincerely,[/b]
[b]dvkin[/b]
[/spoiler]

[size=4]Features :[/size]

[list]
[*]Display Player Names
[*]Display NPC Names
[*][s]Display Child Names[/s]
[*][u][s]Display Horse Names ﻿[/s][/u]
[*][s]Display Pet Names[/s]
[*][s]Display Farm Animal Names[/s]
[/list][b]
Possibility to display or hide directly in-game by default with [color=#ffd966]F5[/color], adjustable in the config file

[size=4]Installation :
[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Download and Install SMAPI[/b]: Ensure you have the latest version of SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) installed. You can download it from the [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI website[/url].
[*][b]Download the Mod[/b]: Download the "Show NPC Names" mod from Nexus Mods.
[*][b]Extract the Mod[/b]: Extract the downloaded archive to your Stardew Valley Mods folder. 
[*][b]Run the Game[/b]: Launch Stardew Valley using the SMAPI launcher. The mod should now be active.
[/list][b][size=4]Configuration :

[/size][/b]A [color=#ffe599][b]config.json[/b] [/color]file is included in the mod's folder. You can edit this file to customize the mod's settings.[b][size=4]
[/size][/b]
Default [b][color=#ffe599]config.json[/color][/b] :

[quote][code]{
  "ShowPlayerName": false,
  "ShowNPCNames": true,
  "NamesDisplayed": true,
  "ToggleNameDisplayKey": "F5"
}
[/code][/quote]
[b][size=4]Configuration Options:

[/size][/b][list][*][b]ShowPlayerNames[/b]: true or false. Default is false. Enables or disables the display of the player's name.
[*][b]ShowNPCNames[/b]: true or false. Default is true. Enables or disables the display of NPC names.
[*]Possibility to display or hide directly in-game by default with F5, adjustable in the config file
[/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b]: This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 or later.
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]: This mod is compatible with multiplayer. All players need to have the mod installed to see the names.
[/list][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][b][size=4]Support:
[/size]
[/b]If you encounter any issues, have suggestions, or need support, contact me.

Downloads.Description: Show NPC Names is a simple yet effective mod for Stardew Valley that displays the names of NPCs (and more) above their heads.

Manifest.Description: Displays NPC names above their heads.
